verdict: Freshchat: Choose Freshchat when live chat and messaging with a free 10-agent tier is the primary job within the Freshworks ecosystem. Scores use the customer-service editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Generous free tier up to 10 agents
Freddy AI and bot deflection on paid tiers
weaknesses: Suite confusion with other Freshworks SKUs
Omnichannel below Zendesk Suite at enterprise scale
bestFor: Freshworks customers wanting live chat as the primary purchase
Teams needing free up-to-10-agents entry with clear upgrade path
Website and in-app messaging with bot deflection
notIdealFor: Full helpdesk ticketing as primary job (Freshdesk)
tradeoffs: Per-agent seats vs ticket/conversation caps and AI outcome pricing
Omnichannel breadth vs SMB simplicity in shared inbox tools
Suite upsell complexity vs transparent published plan floors
ITSM depth vs lightweight live-chat or ecommerce helpdesk fit
recommendation: Choose Freshchat when live chat and messaging with a free 10-agent tier is the primary job within the Freshworks ecosystem. Compare LiveChat for Text-powered chat depth and Tidio for conversation-cap SMB pricing with Lyro AI.
